title: ID0474755-DC/Si-D/CH- [Y2/TN4002939708] Low power charging
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
Low power charging session due to Temperature in Cable
Solution: Fixed itself, most likely an error on the cooling unit that didn't get reported correctly to the PLC

additional_info.subject: ID0474755-DC/Si-D/CH- [Y2/TN4002939708] Charging Issue CRM:03289000371
additional_info.body:
Hi Alex, good morning.
I honestly cannot find any root cause of why this happened, unless it has to do with temperature or the fact that there was an error in the cooling unit that was not reported properly to our PLC.
I believe it's the last since the temperature didn't change that much in that small amount. In this case, we cannot do much since the error is not live anymore.
Also since it's not in v8.1.4, the time that it would take for R&D to analyse would be huge since they are focused on releasing v9 at the moment.
What your opinion?
Thank you!
BEst regards,
Francisco
